next.reason: 1985: "literal-2, literal-3, or the size of the data item referenced by identifier-4, identifier-5 must be one character in length"; 2023: "literal-3 shall be one character in length; identifier-5 ... If it is not, the EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE exception condition is set". 2023 keeps the one-character syntax rule only for literal-3. Literal-2 and identifier-4 are no longer restricted. Identifier-5 size becomes a runtime exception with undefined results.
